# Security Policy

See the root [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for supported versions and development-stack posture.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do **not** open a public GitHub issue.

Report privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Financial-Digital-Twin-Compliance/security/advisories/new).

If that form is unavailable, ask a maintainer to enable private vulnerability reporting, then retry. Include reproduction steps, impact, and a suggested fix when you have one.

We aim to acknowledge reports and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available.
